ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience DAT captures a superb 1990 Deer Creek performance with standout Brown Eyed Women, Peggy-O, Terrapin Station and an epic Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The audience DAT recorded on a Neumann-equipped DAT delivers clear, dynamic sound despite some distance in the early PA, making the show highly listenable. The concert is praised for its relaxed yet vibrant first set and a second set packed with highlights like Brown Eyed Women, Peggy-O, Terrapin Station, The Other One, a legendary Morning Dew, and a fresh encore of The Weight.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted both strong musical moments and good recording quality; the consistent positivity yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: DAT source with excellent Neumann microphones; clear and dynamic overall, though early PA sounds slightly distant. Less crowd noise than typical audience tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is relaxed yet verve‑filled; second set builds intensity with strong jams and a memorable encore, providing an excellent overall pacing.
